caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic mug positioned centrally within a faint pencil-drawn square frame on a beige background. The mug has a rounded body and a small handle attached to its upper right side, facing outward. The surface of the mug is multicolored with a glossy appearance, featuring a mix of yellow, green, brown, blue, and dark purple hues and irregular patches and streaks, giving it a marbled effect. The interior rim of the mug is pale yellow with some shading, and the handle is predominantly yellow with faint green tints. The mug is the only object in the image and is rendered with a realistic style, emphasizing its three-dimensional form and the reflective quality of its surface. There are no other objects or decorations in the drawing apart from the mug and the rectangular outline surrounding it.
title: Large Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
